verdict.rationale: Bench offers an AI Categorization Assistant that identifies transaction categories in real-time and auto-generates categorization rules from business patterns, which is a narrow form of AI-generated suggestion from the user's data. However, there's no evidence of broader AI-generated insights (e.g., spend trend analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, or narrative summaries) beyond reporting dashboards that are static/human-curated rather than AI-generated. missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven financial insights/summaries beyond categorization, no independent corroboration of the AI assistant's real-world performance, no mention of broader agentic or generative insight features.
